final_name.description: From Wapti, head west to the wooden bridge at Whinyard Strait. South West of there, on a cliff overlooking the railway is often a Bald Eagle from 5am to 7pm. [#4]
all_descriptions:
On the cliffs overlooking Scratching Post to the south of Tumbleweed between 9am and 5pm is a good location. Shoot nearby so the eagle takes flight before killing it.
Also on the road from Strawberry, just before Owanjila Dam, there is often one on the rock outcrop. [#1]

Head to Annesburg, and go to the junction for the river crossing just southwest of Deer Cottage. To the east are some cliffs visible from the road, and during the day you will usually find an eagle perched on top of them. Change lobbies to get a spawn. [#2]

South west of Riggs Station, head past Old Man Jones, and then head towards Fort Riggs. Crossing the wooden bridge over the river you will often see a Golden Eagle perched on it during the day. More eagles just to the left of the 'Z' on the map as well. [#3]
From Wapti, head west to the wooden bridge at Whinyard Strait. South West of there, on a cliff overlooking the railway is often a Bald Eagle from 5am to 7pm. [#4]
On the Owanjila Dam, near Strawberry, there is often one. Or it might be on the cliff around the T in Strawberry. [#5]

final_name.description:
At Lagras, there's a patch in the trees by the road just near Harriet, and there's more just north of that.
They're inside the horseshoe curve in the road, between the letters 'L' and 'M' on the map.
Further on too, just below 'A' and 'R' on the map there's a patch either side of the road. [#1]
all_descriptions:
At Lagras, there's a patch in the trees by the road just near Harriet, and there's more just north of that.
They're inside the horseshoe curve in the road, between the letters 'L' and 'M' on the map.
Further on too, just below 'A' and 'R' on the map there's a patch either side of the road. [#1]
Go to Rhodes then head to Shady Belle, and to the northeast of the mansion, just past the tiny jetty you'll find a number of Oleander Sage plants under the trees, should be five of them there. [#2]
